name: Warrior Choker
desc: An antique choker worn by famous tacticians of an age long since passed, as described in history textbooks. While they were previously used as status symbols, nowadays their function has been reduced to fashion.

eff.name: Surprise Strategies
eff.desc1: Boosts ATK of characters within the same range as the holder by [Lv. x 3] and increases damage by [Lv. x 3]% when attacking a stunned enemy.

eff.name: Battle Tactics
eff.desc1: For every 100% Battle Rate you have, increases damage dealt by [Lv. x 1]%.

eff.name: Supply Replenishment
eff.desc1: Restores HP by [Lv. x 1]% when an action is taken.
